title: Dreaming of a Golden Man
synopsis: The story of how Buddhism spread to China during the reign of Emperor Ming of Han.

fullText.simplified:
夜梦金人

    如果你来中国旅游，一定不能错过遍布全国的佛寺。
    据统计，在中国内地就有三万多座佛寺。中国的佛寺如此多，多到什么程度呢？无论你要考什么试，要参加什么比赛，亲戚朋友们总会说：“去佛寺拜一拜吧！”
    那么，这么多的佛寺是怎么出现在中国的呢？那就不得不提到一个特别的皇帝——汉明帝刘庄。
    刘庄是刘秀的儿子，他非常关心百姓，也非常勤俭。可以说，他做了二十多年皇帝，几乎没有修过自己的宫殿。但是，这个节约的皇帝却修了中国第一寺——白马寺。
    据说，有一天晚上，刘庄做了一个梦，梦里出现了一个金人。那个金人有五米多高，头上、背后都有光。他神态安详，飞到皇宫上，俯视着大地。他的光芒如此耀眼，让皇帝都不敢直视。
    刘庄被惊醒了，他思来想去，再也睡不着。第二天和大臣们开会的时候，他就连忙问：“各位，你们都是非常聪明的人，能不能帮我想想，我做的梦是什么意思呢？”
    刘庄描述了自己梦到的金人。大臣们听了，都表示：“这个金人与众不同，一定不是个普通人啊！”
    有一个大臣猜测说：“我听说有一个国家，那里有一个神仙叫‘佛’，您梦到的应该就是‘佛’了！”
    刘庄觉得很好奇。他知道中国的神仙，譬如女娲、盘古，但是外国的神仙和宗教，大家都不太熟悉。即便是听过，也没有去了解过。
    刘庄又问：“那个国家在哪里？离我们有多远？”
    那个大臣回答说：“在中国的西边，听说有几千里远呢！”
    刘庄的心被好奇占据了。他想，既然金人来到了他的梦中，那为什么他不能去寻找那个金人呢？于是，刘庄派遣了十八个人，千里迢迢去西方寻找金人。
    这十八个人启程了。那时候没有手机，也没有飞机，他们几经周折，好不容易才碰上了两个僧人。他们诚挚地邀请僧人来中国一趟，传播佛学。
    两位僧人应邀而来，还带上了一些宝贵的佛经、佛像，走上了这条漫长的路。白马一路驮着佛经、佛像，时隔三年，才终于到了中国。刘庄看到佛像后大吃一惊，说：“这正是我梦中的金人啊！”
    之后，刘庄每天都去听课，两位僧人将佛的故事告诉了他，刘庄更是深受震撼。他将白马带来的佛经、佛像收藏起来，还修了佛寺，取名为“白马寺”。佛教作为宗教，开始正式进入了中国人的视野。
    现在，白马寺已经快要两千岁了。在这两千年里，它不仅是中国人心中的佛教圣地，就连印度、日本、泰国、缅甸也曾捐款帮忙修缮。它象征了国家之间的深情厚谊，是名副其实的“中国第一寺”。走在白马寺，你不仅可以感受中国汉朝的历史，还可以看到其他国家的建筑风格。
    很多信佛的人，还会专程从其他国家跋涉而来，就是为了看一看这座举世瞩目的“白马寺”，听一听新年的钟声。
fullText.traditional:
夜夢金人

    如果你來中國旅遊，一定不能錯過遍布全國的佛寺。
    據統計，在中國內地就有三萬多座佛寺。中國的佛寺如此多，多到什麼程度呢？無論你要考什麼試，要參加什麼比賽，親戚朋友們總會說：“去佛寺拜一拜吧！”
    那麼，這麼多的佛寺是怎麼出現在中國的呢？那就不得不提到一個特別的皇帝——漢明帝劉庄。
    劉庄是劉秀的兒子，他非常關心百姓，也非常勤儉。可以說，他做了二十多年皇帝，幾乎沒有修過自己的宮殿。但是，這個節約的皇帝卻修了中國第一寺——白馬寺。
    據說，有一天晚上，劉庄做了一個夢，夢裡出現了一個金人。那個金人有五米多高，頭上、背後都有光。他神態安詳，飛到皇宮上，俯視著大地。他的光芒如此耀眼，讓皇帝都不敢直視。
    劉庄被驚醒了，他思來想去，再也睡不著。第二天和大臣們開會的時候，他就連忙問：“各位，你們都是非常聰明的人，能不能幫我想想，我做的夢是什麼意思呢？”
    劉庄描述了自己夢到的金人。大臣們聽了，都表示：“這個金人與眾不同，一定不是個普通人啊！”
    有一個大臣猜測說：“我聽說有一個國家，那裡有一個神仙叫‘佛’，您夢到的應該就是‘佛’了！”
    劉庄覺得很好奇。他知道中國的神仙，譬如女媧、盤古，但是外國的神仙和宗教，大家都不太熟悉。即便是聽過，也沒有去了解過。
    劉庄又問：“那個國家在哪裡？離我們有多遠？”
    那個大臣回答說：“在中國的西邊，聽說有幾千里遠呢！”
    劉庄的心被好奇佔據了。他想，既然金人來到了他的夢中，那為什麼他不能去尋找那個金人呢？於是，劉庄派遣了十八個人，千里迢迢去西方尋找金人。
    這十八個人啟程了。那時候沒有手機，也沒有飛機，他們幾經周折，好不容易才碰上了兩個僧人。他們誠摯地邀請僧人來中國一趟，傳播佛學。
    兩位僧人應邀而來，還帶上了一些寶貴的佛經、佛像，走上了這條漫長的路。白馬一路馱著佛經、佛像，時隔三年，才終於到了中國。劉庄看到佛像後大吃一驚，說：“這正是我夢中的金人啊！”
    之後，劉庄每天都去聽課，兩位僧人將佛的故事告訴了他，劉庄更是深受震撼。他將白馬帶來的佛經、佛像收藏起來，還修了佛寺，取名為“白馬寺”。佛教作為宗教，開始正式進入了中國人的視野。
    現在，白馬寺已經快要兩千歲了。在這兩千年裡，它不僅是中國人心中的佛教聖地，就連印度、日本、泰國、緬甸也曾捐款幫忙修繕。它象徵了國家之間的深情厚誼，是名副其實的“中國第一寺”。走在白馬寺，你不僅可以感受中國漢朝的歷史，還可以看到其他國家的建築風格。
    很多信佛的人，還會專程從其他國家跋涉而來，就是為了看一看這座舉世矚目的“白馬寺”，聽一聽新年的鐘聲。

sentences.traditional: 兩位僧人應邀而來，還帶上了一些寶貴的佛經、佛像，走上了這條漫長的路。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng wèi sēng rén yìng yāo ér lái hái dài shàng le yì xiē bǎo guì de fó jīng fó xiàng zǒu shàng le zhè tiáo màn cháng de lù

sentences.simplified: 白马一路驮着佛经、佛像，时隔三年，才终于到了中国。
sentences.traditional: 白馬一路馱著佛經、佛像，時隔三年，才終於到了中國。
sentences.pinyin: bái mǎ yí lù tuó zhe fó jīng fó xiàng shí gé sān nián cái zhōng yú dào le zhōng guó
sentences.english: The two monks accepted the invitation to come and even brought some valuable Buddhist scriptures and statues on the long journey.

sentences.simplified: 刘庄看到佛像后大吃一惊，说：“这正是我梦中的金人啊！”
sentences.traditional: 劉庄看到佛像後大吃一驚，說：“這正是我夢中的金人啊！”
sentences.pinyin: liú zhuāng kàn dào fó xiàng hòu dà chī yì jīng shuō zhè zhèng shì wǒ mèng zhōng de jīn rén a
sentences.english: On the journey, the Buddhist scriptures and statues were carried by white horses. After three years, they finally arrived in China.
When Liu Zhuang saw the Buddhist statues, he was gobsmacked and said, “This is precisely the golden man I saw in my dream!”

sentences.simplified: 之后，刘庄每天都去听课，两位僧人将佛的故事告诉了他，刘庄更是深受震撼。
sentences.traditional: 之後，劉庄每天都去聽課，兩位僧人將佛的故事告訴了他，劉庄更是深受震撼。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu liú zhuāng měi tiān dōu qù tīng kè liǎng wèi sēng rén jiāng fó de gù shi gào su le tā liú zhuāng gèng shì shēn shòu zhèn hàn

sentences.simplified: 他将白马带来的佛经、佛像收藏起来，
sentences.traditional: 他將白馬帶來的佛經、佛像收藏起來，
sentences.pinyin: tā jiāng bái mǎ dài lái de fó jīng fó xiàng shōu cáng qǐ lái
sentences.english: Afterwards, Liu Zhuang went to class every day. The two monks told him the story of Buddha, and Liu Zhuang was even more stunned.

sentences.simplified: 还修了佛寺，取名为“白马寺”。
sentences.traditional: 還修了佛寺，取名為“白馬寺”。
sentences.pinyin: hái xiū le fó sì qǔ míng wéi bái mǎ sì
sentences.english: He stored the Buddhist scriptures and statues that the white horses brought.

sentences.simplified: 佛教作为宗教，开始正式进入了中国人的视野。
sentences.traditional: 佛教作為宗教，開始正式進入了中國人的視野。
sentences.pinyin: fó jiào zuò wéi zōng jiào kāi shǐ zhèng shì jìn rù le zhōng guó rén de shì yě
sentences.english: He also built a Buddhist temple, which he named “White Horse Temple”.
Buddhism as a religion began to officially enter the horizons of Chinese people.

sentences.simplified: 现在，白马寺已经快要两千岁了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，白馬寺已經快要兩千歲了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài bái mǎ sì yǐ jīng kuài yào liǎng qiān suì le

sentences.simplified: 在这两千年里，它不仅是中国人心中的佛教圣地，
sentences.traditional: 在這兩千年裡，它不僅是中國人心中的佛教聖地，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè liǎng qiān nián lǐ tā bù jǐn shì zhōng guó rén xīn zhōng de fó jiào shèng dì
sentences.english: White Horse Temple is now nearly 2,000 years old.

sentences.simplified: 就连印度、日本、泰国、缅甸也曾捐款帮忙修缮。
sentences.traditional: 就連印度、日本、泰國、緬甸也曾捐款幫忙修繕。
sentences.pinyin: jiù lián yìn dù rì běn tài guó miǎn diàn yě céng juān kuǎn bāng máng xiū shàn
sentences.english: During these 2,000 years, it has not only been a sacred place in Buddhism in the minds of Chinese people, ..

sentences.simplified: 它象征了国家之间的深情厚谊，是名副其实的“中国第一寺”。
sentences.traditional: 它象徵了國家之間的深情厚誼，是名副其實的“中國第一寺”。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiàng zhēng le guó jiā zhī jiān de shēn qíng hòu yì shì míng fù qí shí de zhōng guó dì yī sì
sentences.english: .. there have even been donations from India, Japan, Thailand, and Myanmar to help renovate the temple.

sentences.simplified: 走在白马寺，你不仅可以感受中国汉朝的历史，
sentences.traditional: 走在白馬寺，你不僅可以感受中國漢朝的歷史，
sentences.pinyin: zǒu zài bái mǎ sì nǐ bù jǐn kě yǐ gǎn shòu zhōng guó hàn cháo de lì shǐ
sentences.english: This symbolizes the deep friendship between the countries. It is truly deserving of the title “China’s first Buddhist temple”.

sentences.simplified: 还可以看到其他国家的建筑风格。
sentences.traditional: 還可以看到其他國家的建築風格。
sentences.pinyin: hái kě yǐ kàn dào qí tā guó jiā de jiàn zhù fēng gé
sentences.english: Walking around the White Horse Temple, you can not only experience the history of China’s Han Dynasty, ..
.. but also see the architectural styles of other countries.

sentences.simplified: 很多信佛的人，还会专程从其他国家跋涉而来，
sentences.traditional: 很多信佛的人，還會專程從其他國家跋涉而來，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō xìn fó de rén hái huì zhuān chéng cóng qí tā guó jiā bá shè ér lái

sentences.simplified: 就是为了看一看这座举世瞩目的“白马寺”，听一听新年的钟声。
sentences.traditional: 就是為了看一看這座舉世矚目的“白馬寺”，聽一聽新年的鐘聲。
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì wèi le kàn yí kàn zhè zuò jǔ shì zhǔ mù de bái mǎ sì tīng yì tīng xīn nián de zhōng shēng
sentences.english: Many people who believe in Buddhism also make arduous journeys from other countries ..

sentence_translations: Dreaming of a Golden Man
If you travel to China, you shouldn’t miss the Buddhist temples that can be found across the country.
According to the statistics, there are more than 30,000 Buddhist temples in mainland China.
There are so many Buddhist temples in China. How plentiful are they?
Regardless of whether you are taking an examination or participating in a competition, family and friends will always say:
“Go to a Buddhist temple to pray!”
Well then, how did all these Buddhist temples appear in China?
Here we must mention a very special emperor—Emperor Ming of Han, Liu Zhuang.
Liu Zhuang was Liu Xiu’s son. He was very concerned about the common people and was very hardworking and frugal.
It’s safe to say that in more than 20 years as emperor, he hardly built palaces for himself.
However, this frugal emperor built China’s first Buddhist temple—the White Horse Temple.
It is said that one night, Liu Zhuang had a dream in which a golden man appeared.
The golden man was more than five meters tall. There was light above his head and behind him.
His appearance was serene, and he flew to the top of the imperial palace, where he looked down over the earth.
His radiance was so dazzling that the emperor did not dare to look directly at him.
Liu Zhuang was woken from his sleep. He kept on thinking it over and couldn’t fall back to sleep.
The next day when he was having a meeting with his ministers, he hurriedly asked, ..
.. “All of you are very clever people. Can you help me understand what the meaning of my dream is?”
Liu Zhuang described the golden man in his dream.
The ministers listened and said, “This golden man is out of the ordinary. It definitely isn’t a normal person!”
One minister speculated, ”I heard there is a country where there is a supernatural being called ‘Buddha’.
What you saw in your dream was probably ‘Buddha’!”
Liu Zhuang was very curious.
He knew about China’s supernatural beings, such as Nüwa and Pangu, ..
.. but no one was very familiar with foreign supernatural beings and religions.
Even if they had heard of them before, they hadn’t tried to understand them.
Liu Zhuang then asked, “Where is that country? How far is it from us?”
That minister replied, “It is west of China. I heard it is a few thousand li away!”
Liu Zhuang’s mind was filled with curiosity.
He thought, since the golden man had come into his dream, then why shouldn’t he go to look for that golden man?
Hence, Liu Zhuang sent 18 men on a long journey to the west to find the golden man.
The 18 men set off on the journey.
At that time, there were no cell phones, and there were no planes.
They underwent many setbacks and, after much difficulty, finally encountered two monks.
They sincerely invited the monks to come to China to spread Buddhist philosophy.
The two monks accepted the invitation to come and even brought some valuable Buddhist scriptures and statues on the long journey.
On the journey, the Buddhist scriptures and statues were carried by white horses. After three years, they finally arrived in China.
When Liu Zhuang saw the Buddhist statues, he was gobsmacked and said, “This is precisely the golden man I saw in my dream!”
Afterwards, Liu Zhuang went to class every day. The two monks told him the story of Buddha, and Liu Zhuang was even more stunned.
He stored the Buddhist scriptures and statues that the white horses brought.
He also built a Buddhist temple, which he named “White Horse Temple”.
Buddhism as a religion began to officially enter the horizons of Chinese people.
White Horse Temple is now nearly 2,000 years old.
During these 2,000 years, it has not only been a sacred place in Buddhism in the minds of Chinese people, ..
.. there have even been donations from India, Japan, Thailand, and Myanmar to help renovate the temple.
This symbolizes the deep friendship between the countries. It is truly deserving of the title “China’s first Buddhist temple”.
Walking around the White Horse Temple, you can not only experience the history of China’s Han Dynasty, ..
.. but also see the architectural styles of other countries.
Many people who believe in Buddhism also make arduous journeys from other countries ..
.. to see the world-renowned “White Horse Temple” and listen to the New Year’s bell ringing.
